description: Move one change order along and stamp the date and note: draft to sent, sent to approved or rejected, either to void. Backwards steps, an unsent approval and a backdated move are all refused.

change_order.description: The change order id, e.g. CO-2026-0001, or its title when only one carries it

date.description: The day it happened, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

note.description: What happened, e.g. Emailed to the client, or Approved by phone, confirmed in writing
